name: Custom Auto Featured Image
author: Shamiul Bishal

sections.description:
Custom Auto Featured Image Generator is a powerful tool to automatically create consistent, high-quality featured images for your blog posts. Say goodbye to searching for stock photos or manually designing graphics for every article.

Key Features:
* Automated Generation: Automatically generates a featured image when you publish or update a post.
* Professional Templates: Choose from a variety of pre-designed templates (Business, Tech, Lifestyle, Minimal).
* Live Customizer: Adjust fonts, colors, text alignment, and padding with a real-time preview.
* Brand Integration: Upload your own logo and watermark directly onto the images.
* Gradient & Solid Backgrounds: Use custom colors or gradients if you prefer a simpler look.
* Bulk Generation: (Coming Soon) Retroactively generate images for old posts.

How it Works:
1. Go to the AutoFeatured settings page.
2. Select a template style that fits your brand.
3. Customize the typography and upload your logo.
4. That’s it! New posts will automatically get a featured image generated from the post title.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the custom-auto-featured-image folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “AutoFeatured” menu to configure your templates.
sections.faq:
Can I use my own fonts?

The plugin comes with a selection of popular Google Fonts. Custom font uploads are planned for a future version.

Does this work with custom post types?

Yes, you can enable generation for any registered public post type in the settings.
